blurb: Momentum Dance Company provides dance classes for ages 2-18 and competitive dance company options for various age groups. They offer summer camps, technique classes, and audition prep camps. The company participates in national competitions and local performances.
extraNote: Tuition is divided into ten equal monthly payments from September through June · Registration fees are non-refundable · Late payment fee is $35 or 10% of outstanding balance after 5th of month · Withdrawal requires 30 days written notice; tuition due during notice period · No refunds or credits for missed classes; make-up classes allowed when available · Studio closed on major holidays and scheduled breaks; no tuition adjustments for closures · Camp cancellations within 4 weeks of registration may receive refund or credit depending on registration date · Momentum Dance Company 12 E Figueroa Street · Season Thirteen runs from August 31st, 2026 - June 12th, 2027
